verdict.rationale: The data-pipeline axis applies to a robotics platform, but the evidence covers only data capture: rosbag record/play and a Python bag read/write API, including saving synthetic data for training sets (ros2-docs-17, ros2-docs-39, ros2-docs-69). Nothing documents a model-training integration or a way to deploy updated models back to a fleet. Bag recording is a developer building block toward the loop, not the closed training-and-deployment loop itself, so it earns no partial credit; the reviewer's concern is valid on this evidence.
